source: Per-company AR extraction (Screener.in PDFs + IR sites) — Claude.ai routine, daily batch of 20

rate_sensitive.evidence: Company described as 'almost debt free' with low debt-to-equity (~15%); no floating-rate-specific breakdown found.

rate_sensitive.evidence: 'Total borrowing at variable rate was ₹176.74 crores as at March 31, 2025 (March 31, 2024 - ₹209.63 crores)'; Group uses interest rate swaps to hedge floating-rate loan variability

pli_scheme.evidence: PLI schemes cited only as a macro tailwind for India's manufacturing sector in RBI commentary reproduced in MD&A — not specific to IHCL's hospitality business
